note: Tahoe National Forest campground in Jeffrey and lodgepole pine between Hwy 89 and the Truckee River, about a mile south of Truckee; several east-side sites overlook the river. Sites 7-23 (odd numbers), 47-53 and 67-68 sit beside the highway and hear its traffic. --Claude
summary: FS page, recreation.gov facility/rates/per-site catalog and imagery read. $22 single / $44 double; extra vehicle $10 (rec.gov; FS says $5); 72 sites (65 RV/trailer to 65 ft, 7 walk-in tent); no hookups (confirmed), vault toilets + drinking water; season 05-21..10-11 (approx.); reservable with some first-come sites. Riverview kept after a hard look. Phone '' -> 530-587-3558. No closure (off-season only).
flags: WATERFRONT 'riverview' KEPT after a hard check. The Truckee River here is ~22-28 m wide (creek-size under the 30 m rule, so any on-water value would be creekside). Closest RV sites to the water, all on the east side and all behind the tree/brush line on the bank: 031 (39.30120,-120.20432) ~26-30 m, 034 (39.30207,-120.20459) and 032/033 (39.30194,-120.20451) ~31-35 m, 064 (39.29900,-120.20450) ~35 m, 043 (39.30050,-120.20440) ~39 m, 041 ~45-50 m; all are reservable and posted 36-50 ft. FS: 'Several sites overlook the Truckee River'. A creekside lead at most if the reviewer reads the bank as open; not upgraded. The stored evidence's claim that 'on-river sites (#69-75)' are walk-in tent sites is wrong: rec.gov and the FS put the walk-ins 69-75 at the south end beside Hwy 89. Proposed evidence: 'rec.gov site points on Esri imagery 2026-11-27: east-side sites 031/032-034/043/064 are 26-40 m from the ~25 m-wide Truckee River behind a tree and brush line on the bank; walk-in tent sites 69-75 sit by Hwy 89; FS "several sites overlook the Truckee River" -> riverview.'
PHONE: stored '' -> 530-587-3558 (Truckee Ranger District, recreation.gov facility phone). In season the concessionaire's local line is (530) 606-3978.
FEES: extra vehicle $10 a night on recreation.gov's notice vs '$5 per vehicle per night' on the FS page; rec.gov written. High $22 -> $44 (double sites 032/033, 050/052).
FACILITIES: the FS amenity block says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' while the FS description and recreation.gov both say drinking water is provided; kept true on the two statements.
SITES: count 70 -> 72 (catalog, besides the host; FS says 70). max_rig_ft 65 added (016, 024); most sites 35-50 ft, a 23-ft rig fits all 65 RV/trailer sites.
PIN: stored 39.3025,-120.2045 is ~230 m north of the site centroid (39.30043,-120.20495), beside site 14; under the 250 m line, optional move.
STATUS: open; FS 'Site Closed' is the off-season. Tahoe NF alerts carry only a prescribed-fire pile notice (Truckee Landing).
